versions.changelog: Adds enforced contract v2 support for all eight approved squads, safe draft-only execution, exact connector and destination binding for approved outbound actions, tamper-resistant idempotency, capability discovery, and authoritative provider receipts. Excludes test-only loaders and Python bytecode from the distributable so all ClawHub scanners can inspect it safely.

promarkia 1.1.2

- Strengthened and expanded authorization requirements and workflow in SKILL.md, including structured task modes, explicit UUID authorization, and metadata for external actions.
- Replaced previous `--confirm-credit-use`/`--confirm-external-action` flags with a stricter mode/manifest-driven contract; clarified rejection and idempotency logic.
- Added instructions for UUID generation and updated command-line usage for submitting tasks.
- Added tests/test_promarkia_run.py; removed old skill-card.md.

- Restricted activation: Skill now runs only on explicit Promarkia requests to list squads, submit a task to an approved squad, or retrieve a specific run—never for generic marketing tasks.
- Reduced scope: Only approved marketing squads (IDs 9, 10, 11, 12, 16, 17, 18, 21) are allowed; all other squad requests are rejected.
- Stronger authorization: Explicit user confirmation is required before transmitting prompts, using credits, or performing any publish/contact/external action.
- Security improvements: Prompts are sanitized to remove credentials and unrelated data; results are always treated as untrusted output.
- Clarified usage: The client no longer supports creating or modifying recurring tasks and always involves an explicit, gated workflow for each run.
- Documentation cleanup: Removed unused or outdated documentation files and tightened instructions.

- No user-facing or backend changes in this release.
- Version updated with no modifications to features, documentation, or code.

- Added homepage URL and enhanced metadata section in SKILL.md
- Declared required environment variable (PROMARKIA_API_KEY) and file paths metadata
- No changes to functionality or code; documentation/meta update only
